proves.claim: pullboard inbox --wait 1 blocks while an item is open, then returns within 10 s of a shout addressed to the coordinator, printing that shout

cli.journeys-inbox-wait.returns-on-coord.why: A coordinator in a plain loop had no call that blocks until a shout, so it polled and answered seats in minutes.

proves.claim: pullboard inbox --wait 1 returns at once, printing that nothing is open, when every item is landed or withdrawn

cli.journeys-inbox-wait.returns-when-not.why: Without it a coordinator would wait out its minutes on a board with nothing left to answer.
